info.title: OloVoice Public API
info.description:
Start outbound phone calls, run browser/web calls, create leads, manage assistants, and pull call logs, recordings, and metrics.

This reference is generated from a code-verified read of the live API routes. The public gateway strips the internal `/api/v1` and `/api/public` prefixes, so you call `POST /call`, `GET /call-logs`, etc.

tags.name: Calls
tags.description: Start outbound phone and web calls.

tags.name: Call Logs
tags.description: Read call logs and signed recording URLs.

tags.name: Assistants
tags.description: Manage the AI assistants that drive your calls.

post.description:
Start an **outbound phone call**. Dials `customer.number` from the org number `phoneNumberId`, driven by an assistant, squad, or workflow.

All field names are camelCase. `serverUrl` and every tool `webhookUrl` must be HTTPS.

200.description: Request accepted. Inspect `carrier`: `success: true` can still mean the dialer skipped the call.

payload.firstMessage: Hi, how can I help you today?
payload.content: You are a helpful assistant. Answer the user's questions clearly.

value.error: customer.number geçerli bir telefon numarası olmalıdır
Organizasyon eşzamanlı çağrı limitine ulaştı. Lütfen diğer görüşmeler tamamlandıktan sonra tekrar deneyin.

allOf.description: At least one selector is required. A direct assistant request must carry its prompts; squad/workflow requests may hydrate them from the saved graph.
Classic audio requires both TTS and STT. OpenAI realtime half-cascade requires TTS; native-audio requires neither.

schema.description: All field names are camelCase — snake_case returns `400`.

assistantId.description: Assistant to run. One of assistantId/squadId/workflowId is required.

squadId.description: Squad to run (resolves its own entry assistant).

workflowId.description: Workflow to run (resolves its own start node).

phoneNumberId.description: Org phone number to dial from. Must support outbound and have a trunk configured.

number.description: Destination number. Must match `^\+?[0-9]{6,20}$`. E.164 recommended.

firstMessage.description: Opening line. Required unless the squad/workflow supplies it.

content.description: System prompt. Required unless the squad/workflow supplies it.

serverUrl.description: HTTPS post-call report webhook. HTTPS only.

privacy.description: Compatibility input. Omission is normalized to `{}`; effective `recordCalls`, `hipaaCompliant`, and `ologuardEnabled` values always come from the saved assistant policy and cannot be overridden per call.

predefinedFunctions.description: Optional built-in tools (end-call, keypad, DTMF). Omission is normalized to `{}`.

toolIds.description: IDs of saved tools (must belong to your org).

extras.description: Free-form metadata. `extras.mem0Enabled` is a reserved boolean compatibility signal, not a per-call switch; the server derives the effective Olophin value from the organization package and saved assistant.

example.firstMessage: Hi, how can I help you today?
example.content: You are a helpful assistant. Answer the user's questions clearly.

post.description:
Start a **phoneless (web/browser/app) call**. Creates an OloVoice real-time session, assigns the assistant, and returns a short-lived participant token your client uses over WebRTC.

> Server-to-server only — never ship the API key to a browser. Return only the `token` (+ `connectionUrl`, `roomName`, `callId`). Browser CORS is disabled by default; use your own backend proxy.

Gated behind the `PUBLIC_WEB_CALL_ENABLED` server flag (returns `403 web_call_disabled` when off). Shares the single org concurrency pool with `/call`. The token defaults to 60 seconds and permits only session join, microphone publishing, and subscribing to agent audio. `costs`, `costConfig`, `cost_config`, `costCurrency`, and `webParticipantJoinTimeoutSeconds` are server-owned and return `400 server_owned_field` if supplied.

schema.description: `organizationId` is required and must equal your API key's organization. One of `assistantId`/`squadId`/`workflowId` is required. Same camelCase config objects as `/call` (a top-level `toolIds` is ignored — use inline `tools`). Server-owned cost and participant-timeout fields are rejected with `400 server_owned_field`.

organizationId.description: Must equal the API key's organization. Tenant-mismatch guard, not auth.

name.description: Display name only — a web call is not dialed.

number.description: Optional stable customer identity metadata. Never dialed; may be used for phone-keyed Olophin continuity. Prefer E.164.

privacy.description: Compatibility input; effective recording, HIPAA, and OloGuard values come from the saved assistant policy and cannot be overridden per web call.

get.description:
Paginated list of your organization's call logs, newest first. Responses are sanitized for API-key access (internal metric fields and the OloGuard PII block are stripped; `toolRuns` is returned). Rate limit: 60 requests / 60 seconds.

Only `limit`, `page`, and `organizationId` are honored — other filters are ignored.

firstMessage.description: Opening line. Send `null` to clear it.

content.description: System prompt (aka mainPrompt). Send `null` to clear it.

serverUrl.description: HTTPS webhook. Send `null` to clear it.

conversation.description: Conversation settings, including `mem0Enabled` and OloFocus fields: `noiseCancellationMode`, `oloFocusModel`, `oloFocusEnhancementLevel`, `vadProvider`, and noisy-environment warning controls.

privacy.description: Authoritative assistant recording, HIPAA, and OloGuard policy. `ologuardEnabled` is preserved on update if omitted.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an assistant owned by your org. Existing call logs are kept.

post.description: Creates a lead and optionally triggers an outbound call. The organization is derived from the API key. Requires the **Lead Management** package. `call.status` is `called` | `queued` | `skipped` | `failed`. Response keys are snake_case (`lead_id`).

metadata.description: Free-form. Exposed to the prompt as `{{lead_<key>}}` (keys must match `^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$`).

categoryId.description: If the category has both an assistant and phone number, an outbound call is placed automatically.

campaignId.description: Links the lead into a campaign. Unknown IDs soft-warn.

get.description: Aggregated call analytics over a date range: summary, daily trends, hourly activity, duration distribution, disconnect reasons, sentiment, funnel, top assistants, and tool usage. Latency values are in milliseconds.

value.error: Custom tarih aralığı için startDate ve endDate (YYYY-MM-DD) zorunludur.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD (end-of-day UTC). Required only when range=custom.

parameters.name: assistantId
parameters.description: Filter to one assistant. `all` == no filter.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Optional. If sent, must equal the API key's organization, else `403 Forbidden`.

bearerAuth.description: Send `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`. Each operation declares its API-key scope in `x-required-scopes`.

RuntimeLlmConfig.description: Runtime LLM settings. `provider` and `model` are required so an accepted dispatch can initialize the worker.

RuntimeTtsConfig.description: Runtime TTS settings. `provider` is always required when this field is supplied. ElevenLabs/OpenAI require `model` and `voiceId`; AWS Polly requires `voiceId` and defaults `model` to `polly-neural`; Freya/Nova provide model and voice defaults. On `/call`, the whole field may be omitted only for OpenAI realtime native-audio; `/web-call` may omit it and hydrate the saved assistant config.

RuntimeSttConfig.description: Runtime STT override. It is additive-merged with the stored assistant STT settings, so a providerless partial override such as `{ language: "tr" }` is valid. Runtime calls may use string or object keyword entries.

RuntimeBackgroundAudioConfig.description: Runtime background audio. Required on `/call`; may be `{}`. Runtime ambient/thinking values may be builtin strings or provider objects.

OpenAiRealtimeLlm.description: An LLM configuration that the server normalizes as OpenAI realtime.

realtimeMode.description: Defaults to halfCascade for recognized realtime providers/models. nativeAudio also requires the server-side OPENAI_REALTIME_NATIVE_AUDIO_ENABLED rollout flag.

CarrierResponse.description: The carrier's successful 2xx body is passed through. Object acknowledgements may be accepted, skipped, or duplicate; non-JSON text is returned as a string and any valid JSON value may be returned. `callId` is optional here—use `payload.callId` as the stable identifier.

payload.description: The normalized call payload. `callId` is the stable identifier even when the carrier reports a skip.

AssistantSttSettings.description: Canonical assistant STT response. `keywords` entries are objects.

AssistantSttSettingsInput.description: Assistant STT create/update input. `provider` is required. `keywords` and its accepted alias `keywordBoosts` use `{ phrase, boost }` entries; string entries would be discarded by persistence.

AssistantBackgroundAudioInput.description: Assistant background-audio input. `ambient` accepts a builtin string or clip object; canonical `thinking` input is a clip object. A thinking string is not preserved.

CreateAssistantResponse.description: The normal success returns the assistant. If the post-insert read-back fails, the API still returns 201 with `assistantId` and `warning`.

UpdateAssistantResponse.description: The normal success returns the assistant. If the post-update read-back fails, the API returns `success: true` with a warning and no assistant.

CallLog.description: Sanitized public call log. Pending, failed, or artifact-suppressed calls can return null detail fields.

payload.description: Always null on the public call-log routes; raw internal payloads are not exposed.
